entities.name: Paul L. Freeman Jr.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paul Lamar Freeman Jr. was a United States Army four-star general who served as Commander in Chief, United States Army Europe/Commander, Central Army Group from 1962 to 1965 and Commanding General, Continental Army Command from 1965 to 1967.
